title: Reclassify GridLayout as an atom and extract a dependency-free Card atom from EntitySummary
objective: Apply the owner's Atomic Design rule (a component that composes no other Grafting component is an atom; a component that composes an atom is a molecule, and so on) to this package: move GridLayout from organisms/ to atoms/ since it only wraps react-grid-layout directly, and extract the antd Card usage inside EntitySummary into its own reusable Card atom so EntitySummary becomes a molecule that composes Card + Text + StatusBadge instead of wrapping antd Card directly. The Card atom is meant for the owner to compose into Architecture Studio's X6 node view in place of the current EntitySummary-as-node-view, as a container that will receive more content over time.
risks: This task intentionally does not touch apps/architecture-studio or packages/x6-canvas; the owner asked for the Card atom specifically so they can compose it into the X6 node view themselves.

EntitySummary's public props (EntitySummaryProps) must not change; only its private implementation moves from a raw antd Card to the new Card atom, so existing consumers (the X6 canvas React-node bridge) remain unaffected.
Per DEC-053/ADR-0015, this task will prepare uncommitted changes only; the repository owner must review and create the actual Git commit.
